title: February 2026 California and New York and Cannabis Policy Updates
summary: February 2026 brought significant cannabis policy updates in both California and New York, with implications for licensed dispensaries, distributors, beverage manufacturers, and multi-state operators. California’s proposed AB 1826 would refine recall, embargo, and product destruction procedures, directly affecting compliance workflows and inventory risk management. In New York, lawmakers enacted a zoning fix protecting more than 150 licensed dispensaries from closure, while a newly introduced bill (A10191) proposes allowing liquor and wine stores to sell low-potency (≤5mg THC) cannabis beverages under a new retail permit structure. Together, these developments signal continued regulatory evolution in mature and emerging cannabis markets, reinforcing the importance of legislative monitoring for operators navigating compliance, retail expansion, and beverage distribution strategy in 2026.
